competency_statement_fil: Isagawa ang episyente, epektibo at sustainable na mga gawi sa lugar ng trabaho.
competency_statement_en: Exercise efficient and effective sustainable practices in the workplaces

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tinutukoy ang resource, pinagmulan ng aksaya at simpleng baseline.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Identifies the resource, source of waste and a simple baseline.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Puro reklamo sa budget ngunit walang tiyak na nasasayang.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only complains about budget without naming waste.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nagbibigay ng konkretong halimbawa at maihahambing na bilang.
levels.kaya_na_en: Gives a concrete example and comparable count.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakakahanap ng aksaya matapos gumamit ng guided checklist.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Finds waste using a guided checklist.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ipinapalagay na lahat ng konsumo ay aksaya.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Pinoprotektahan ang hand hygiene, critical equipment at clinical single-use rules.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Protects hand hygiene, critical equipment and clinical single-use rules.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagmumungkahi ng reuse o pagsasara na makapipinsala sa care.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Proposes reuse or shutdown that would harm care.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tinatanggal ang hindi kailangan habang malinaw ang safety boundary.
levels.kaya_na_en: Removes unnecessary use while clearly preserving safety boundaries.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naibabago ang mungkahi matapos ipakita ang safety consequence.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Revises the proposal after a safety consequence is pointed out.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ipinagpipilitan ang bawas-gastos kahit makompromiso ang kaligtasan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Insists on cost reduction despite compromising safety.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ipinapaliwanag ang napagkasunduang routine, owner at reporting contact.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Explains the agreed routine, owner and reporting contact.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Utos lamang ang pagbabago at walang may-ari.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: The change is an instruction without ownership.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nakikipagkasundo sa kasama at nakapaghahanda ng naipapasang checklist.
levels.kaya_na_en: Agrees with colleagues and prepares a transferable checklist.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May routine ngunit kulang ang handoff o review date hangga’t hindi ma-prompt.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has a routine but needs prompting for handoff or review date.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Sariling diskarte lamang na hindi kayang sundan ng kapalit.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Relies on an individual workaround a replacement cannot follow.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ikinukumpara ang resource use sa workload at kalidad.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Compares resource use against workload and quality.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Raw total lang ang batayan ng success kahit bumaba ang serbisyo.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Claims success from raw totals even when service declined.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang ratio at quality check ang ginagamit sa pagpasya kung itutuloy.
levels.kaya_na_en: Uses the correct ratio and quality check to decide whether to continue.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naitatama ang paghahambing matapos ipaalala ang session count.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Corrects the comparison after a reminder about session counts.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi matukoy kung aksaya o serbisyong kailangan ang nabawasan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot distinguish reduced waste from reduced necessary service.
